prompts.sheet1: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas for a Korean Three Kingdoms strategy game, sheet 1 of 5. Create exactly 20 original painted portrait busts in a PERFECT edge-to-edge GRID of 5 columns and 4 rows, equal rectangular cells, NO gutters, NO labels, NO text, NO watermark, NO external borders. Square 2048x2048 canvas if possible. Each portrait stays strictly inside its own cell, centered head and shoulders with complete headwear visible. Cohesive refined hand-painted historical illustration, muted jade green, aged gold, ink outlines, parchment gray solid backgrounds, warm light, recognizable distinct faces and attire, ancient Chinese late Han and Three Kingdoms era. These are original interpretations, do not reproduce an existing game's artwork. Order left to right by row: row1 Liu Bei (benevolent middle-aged man with long ears, modest green robe), Cao Cao (sharp eyes, short beard, burgundy brocade), Sun Quan (young regal man reddish beard, jade ceremonial hat), Guan Yu (long flowing black beard, red face, green robe), Zhang Fei (wild full beard, fierce dark armor). row2 Zhao Yun (handsome silver-armored youthful spear general), Ma Chao (white plumed helmet, noble young warrior), Huang Zhong (elderly long white beard archer), Lu Bu (twin long red pheasant feathers, imposing ornate armor), Zhang Liao (stern middle-aged helmeted commander). row3 Dian Wei (broad muscular bald warrior), Xu Chu (round powerful armored tiger guard), Xiahou Dun (one-eyed bearded black-armored commander), Taishi Ci (noble upright armored bow general), Gan Ning (roguish headband, bells at shoulders). row4 Zhou Yu (elegant handsome commander red cloak), Lu Xun (young scholarly general dark-green robe), Zhuge Liang (tall scholar hat, feather fan, calm long beard), Sima Yi (aged calculating scholar deep blue headdress), Deng Ai (weathered scarred frontier general). Crucial: exactly five evenly spaced busts in each of four even rows, consistent crop and scale, each face visually distinct and beautifully painted.
